effects.effect: The gods favor your thievery with magic. Whenever you make a [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) that uses a skill you have from the [intrigue skill group](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/skill.group/intrigue), you can use [Presence](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/presence) on the [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test) instead of another [characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic).
